info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Package treasury is the reserve fund behind every payout: real capital, held and accounted for.

get.summary: Returns the whole treasury board for a SuperAdmin: the reserve fund report, the recent double-entry journal, and the Hanzo L1 anchor status of the ledger root.
get.description:
Returns the whole treasury board for a SuperAdmin: the reserve
fund report, the recent double-entry journal, and the Hanzo L1 anchor status of
the ledger root. ?limit= bounds the journal page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the journal entries returned. Out of range or unparseable takes the default.

post.summary: Commits the current ledger root to Hanzo L1, making the books tamper-evident on chain, and returns the anchoring status.
post.description:
Commits the current ledger root to Hanzo L1, making the books
tamper-evident on chain, and returns the anchoring status. When the chain path
is wired it signs and submits the anchor transaction and records it; when it is
not, it returns the root that WOULD be committed plus the exact remaining
wiring step and records nothing false. A submit that fails still answers 200
with the anchor's own status set to "error" — the attempt is the product.
SuperAdmin only.

put.summary: Installs the reserve's threshold MPC wallet as the signer for on-chain anchors, and returns its EVM address so an operator can fund it for gas.
put.description:
Installs the reserve's threshold MPC wallet as the signer
for on-chain anchors, and returns its EVM address so an operator can fund it
for gas. It provisions-or-resolves the caller org's treasury wallet on the
deployed MPC ring and installs it, so every later anchor commits the ledger
root SIGNED BY THE QUORUM WALLET instead of a lone KMS key. Idempotent — a
repeat resolves the same wallet, which is why the address is a PUT. SuperAdmin
only.

post.summary: Sets the revenue-share basis points a sweep accrues into the reserve fund and returns the stored policy.
post.description:
Sets the revenue-share basis points a sweep accrues into the
reserve fund and returns the stored policy. 0–10000; the change is audited.
SuperAdmin only.

post.summary: Injects bootstrap capital into the reserve fund so backed payouts can begin before the first revenue-share sweep, and returns the journal entry it wrote.
post.description:
Injects bootstrap capital into the reserve fund so backed payouts
can begin before the first revenue-share sweep, and returns the journal entry
it wrote. A repeat of the same ref is at-most-once and reports created=false.
SuperAdmin only.

post.summary: Posts the revenue-share accrual for one period — revenue into the reserve fund, at the current policy's basis points — and returns what it moved.
post.description:
Posts the revenue-share accrual for one period — revenue into the
reserve fund, at the current policy's basis points — and returns what it moved.
It is idempotent per period: a re-run of a period already swept accrues nothing
and reports created=false. SuperAdmin only.

get.summary: Returns the ledger accounts the caller may see, with their balances.
get.description:
Returns the ledger accounts the caller may see, with their
balances. It is tenant-isolated SERVER-SIDE: an ordinary caller sees ONLY
accounts under its own "org:<tenant>:" prefix, never house accounts and never
another tenant's. A SuperAdmin may widen with ?scope=house (the reserve,
revenue and payout house accounts) or ?org=<tenant> — the only way to cross the
tenant boundary, and only for platform sudo. The answer is honestly empty until
a tenant has ledger postings.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Scope is "house" to read the reserve/revenue/payout house accounts. SuperAdmin only.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Org names another tenant to read. SuperAdmin only; ignored when scope=house.

get.summary: Returns the reserve fund's health and the current revenue-share policy for any validated caller.
get.description:
Returns the reserve fund's health and the current revenue-share
policy for any validated caller. It is a TRANSPARENCY view — a partner or
author can see that the pool backing their payouts is solvent — and NOT per-org
money, which is the customer's own commerce balance at /v1/billing/balance. The
policy is read-only here; only a SuperAdmin sets it.

amount.description: the entry's magnitude (display; postings hold the signed truth)
signed 18-decimal USD (1e-18); Σ over an entry == 0

paidCents.description: lifetime backed payouts out of the fund

solventForPayout.description: reserve > 0: at least some payout is backable

address.description: Address is the ledger account address ("org:acme:wallet", "fund:reserve", …).

balanceCents.description: BalanceCents is that account's signed balance in minor units.

accounts.description: Accounts are the ledger accounts in scope with their balances.

scope.description: Scope is the scope actually served: "org" or "house".

tenant.description: Tenant is the org whose accounts these are (empty for the house scope's own rows).

anchor.description: Anchor is the Hanzo L1 anchoring status of the ledger root.

journal.description: Journal is the recent double-entry entries, newest first.

report.description: Report is the reserve-fund snapshot — available, accrued, paid, per-program, policy.

msg.description: Msg carries an operator-facing note; empty on success.

status.description: Status is "ok" on success; the transport maps a non-ok envelope to an error.

anchor.description: Anchor is the Hanzo L1 anchoring status of the ledger root after this call.

msg.description: Msg carries an operator-facing note; empty on success.

status.description:
Status is "ok" on success. A submit that failed still answers ok with the
anchor's own status set to "error" — the attempt is the product.

currentRoot.description: 0x… root of the journal as it stands now

lastRoot.description: The last committed on-chain anchor (nil-fields until the first successful submit).

synced.description: true when the last anchored root == the current root

policy.description: Policy is the revenue-share configuration as stored.

msg.description: Msg carries an operator-facing note; empty on success.

revenueShareBps.description:
RevenueShareBps is the share of net platform revenue a sweep accrues into the
reserve fund, in basis points. 0–10000; 2000 (20%) is the platform default.

created.description: Created is false when this ref had already been seeded — the injection is at-most-once.

entry.description: Entry is the journal entry the injection wrote.

reserveCents.description: ReserveCents is the fund balance after the injection.

msg.description: Msg carries an operator-facing note; empty on success.

amountCents.description: AmountCents is the capital to inject, in minor units. Must be > 0.

memo.description: Memo is the operator's note on the entry. Empty takes "reserve capital injection".

ref.description: Ref is an idempotency key. Without one each seed is a distinct injection.

boundAnchorSigner.description: BoundAnchorSigner is the EVM address now signing anchors. Fund it for gas.

chainId.description: ChainID is the EVM chain the signer is bound for.

org.description: Org is the org whose treasury wallet was resolved.

msg.description: Msg carries an operator-facing note; empty on success.

accruedCents.description: AccruedCents is the amount moved into the reserve fund.

created.description: Created is false when this period had already been swept — the accrual is idempotent.

period.description: Period is the period actually accrued.

reserveCents.description: ReserveCents is the fund balance after the accrual.

revenueCents.description: RevenueCents is the revenue the share was computed from.

msg.description: Msg carries an operator-facing note; empty on success.

period.description: Period is the accrual period as YYYY-MM. Empty takes the current UTC month.

revenueCents.description: RevenueCents is the net platform revenue measured for the period, in minor units. Must be >= 0.
